issue.detail: Spec says 'active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero' but does not specify whether reset is synchronous to posedge clk only. Contract assumes sync reset on posedge. Alternative: reset could be asynchronous or level-sensitive. Distinguishing sequence: apply reset=1 with d=0xFF before any clock edge; if async, q becomes 0 immediately; if sync, q remains previous until posedge.
issue.spec_evidence: active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero
issue.alternative: Reset is asynchronous active-high, clearing q immediately when reset=1 regardless of clock edge.

issue.detail: Spec does not define behavior when reset and d change simultaneously at posedge. Contract prioritizes reset (priority 1). Alternative: d capture could take precedence. Distinguishing sequence: at posedge with reset=1 and d=0xAA, contract outputs q=0; alternative outputs q=0xAA.
issue.alternative: D input capture has priority over synchronous reset when both are active at posedge.
